get.description: Verifies `state`, requires the `activity:read_all` scope, exchanges the code for tokens, stores the athlete with encrypted tokens and enqueues the initial backfill. If the login carried an allowlisted `return_to`, the browser is redirected (303) there with `connected=1`, or with `connect_error=<reason>` once the state itself is valid.

400.description: Bad state, denied access, missing scope or bad code

get.description: Redirects the browser to Strava's authorize page with a signed, expiring `state`. An optional `return_to` that exactly matches `OAUTH_RETURN_TO_ALLOWLIST` is signed into the state; after the callback the browser is sent there. Any other value is ignored.

parameters.description: Where to send the browser after connecting (allowlisted URLs only)
parameters.name: return_to

schema.description: Where to send the browser after connecting (allowlisted URLs only)
schema.title: Return To

get.summary: Readiness: PostgreSQL and Redis are reachable

parameters.name: from

get.description: One stored activity of an active athlete, by its Strava id. Unknown and soft-deleted activities are 404.
Local foods only (manual entries and cached Open Food Facts products): case-insensitive substring of name or brand, or an exact barcode. Favorites first, then by name.

post.description: A manual food with per-100 g values. Unknown macros may be null.

get.description: Exactly one of `barcode` or `q`. A barcode already stored is answered locally (`remote=cached`). Otherwise Open Food Facts is asked (3 s budget) and every usable product (barcode, name and kcal known) is cached in the food list. If Open Food Facts is slow or down the answer still comes, with local matches only and `remote=unavailable`.

400.description: Neither or both of barcode and q

get.summary: Look a food up in Open Food Facts

patch.description: Changes only the fields sent. Editing a cached Open Food Facts food turns it into a `manual` one, so a later lookup never overwrites the edit. Logged entries use the food's current values.

400.description: A required field set to null

get.description: Entries of one day (default: today, UTC), in meal order, then as logged.

put.description: Upsert by the client-generated `client_id`: `201` when it created the entry, `200` when an entry with this id already existed and was updated. Retrying the same request stores one entry.

get.description: Profile, targets and today's BMR estimate.

put.description: Replaces the profile. A `kcal_target` below the estimated BMR is accepted and comes back with a `warning`.

get.description: One day (default: today, UTC). All energy figures are estimates: BMR by Mifflin-St Jeor from the profile and the latest body weight on or before the day, times the everyday-activity multiplier (1.2 / 1.375 / 1.55) without exercise; exercise from synced activities (`raw.calories`, else for rides `raw.kilojoules` ≈ kcal, else unknown). Balance = intake - (baseline + known exercise). Unknown inputs are flagged, never guessed. Days are UTC days.
get.summary: Daily nutrition summary and energy balance

get.description: One summary per day in `from`..`to` (both inclusive, at most 92 days) plus totals. Defaults to the current ISO week (Monday to Sunday, UTC). All energy figures are estimates: BMR by Mifflin-St Jeor from the profile and the latest body weight on or before the day, times the everyday-activity multiplier (1.2 / 1.375 / 1.55) without exercise; exercise from synced activities (`raw.calories`, else for rides `raw.kilojoules` ≈ kcal, else unknown). Balance = intake - (baseline + known exercise). Unknown inputs are flagged, never guessed. Days are UTC days.
get.summary: Nutrition summary per day for a range

get.description: Count, distance, moving time and elevation for activities whose start date falls in `from`..`to` (both inclusive, UTC days), the same totals per sport type (sorted by sport type), and the longest activity: the one with the greatest distance, the newest on a tie. An empty range gives zeros, an empty `by_sport` and a null `longest`. Defaults to the last 12 weeks. Soft-deleted activities are excluded.

Count, distance, moving time and elevation per ISO week (Monday start, UTC) for activities whose start date falls in `from`..`to` (both inclusive). Weeks without activities are returned with zeros. Defaults to the last 12 weeks. Soft-deleted activities are excluded.
Latest backfill and incremental run per active athlete, webhook intake and retry counts, current Strava rate-limit usage, and the circuit breaker state of every process that talks to Strava.
Strava calls this once when the subscription is created. Echoes `hub.challenge` when `hub.mode=subscribe` and `hub.verify_token` matches `STRAVA_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`.

post.description: Validates the event, stores it once (deduplicated on subscription, object, aspect and event time) and enqueues `process_webhook_event`. Always answers 200 for a well-formed event, including duplicates and events for another subscription, so Strava does not retry. No Strava call happens here.

400.description: Body is not a valid Strava event
